final: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(GOT) AS average_GOT, AVG(RBC) AS average_RBC FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_GOT) AS mean_patient_GOT FROM patient_averages) SELECT p.ID, p.average_GOT, p.average_RBC, p.average_GOT - o.mean_patient_GOT AS difference FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_patient_GOT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC, p.ID LIMIT 10
